## saveLocalConfigSync() function

Save local config to file (sync).

Adds version field (version: 1) if not present for forward compatibility. Validates using the migrex migration graph before saving.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare function saveLocalConfigSync(config: LocalConfig, configPath?: string): void;
```
